statements.status_notes: The advisory identifies org.eclipse.jetty.client.util.DigestAuthentication as the vulnerable class. That class is provided by the jetty-client artifact, which is absent from the Cassandra Reaper image SBOM and bundled application JAR. The scanner-reported jetty-security artifact does not contain the vulnerable class; Cassandra Reaper uses Apache HttpClient 5 for its HTTP client functionality.
